description: This file defines a React component 'DndColumnMetricSelect' used for selecting and managing columns and metrics via drag-and-drop in a data exploration UI, including handling of adhoc metrics, columns, and visualizations.

methods.name: isAggregatedDeckGLChart
methods.description: Checks if the visualization type is one of the aggregated Deck.GL chart types.

methods.name: fieldHasMultipleValues
methods.description: Determines if a tooltip item has multiple values based on chart type and item properties.

methods.name: isDictionaryForAdhocMetric
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a dictionary suitable for creating an AdhocMetric.
